drivers_priors: Summer cash/cutout highs typically fade into Q4 as production peaks; front-Q4 contracts (V, Z) usually converge downward, so V/Z is a 'summer premium unwind' seasonal.

Basis: cash and cutout seasonality (see AMS LM_HG201 & PK600) run hardest in July–September; the front leg carries the seasonal risk premium while the back leg is more anchored to placement-cycle expectations.
PSF (pork stocks-frozen) draws and cold-storage disposition drive the G/J and Z/G legs — winter freezer draw supports G relative to H/J deferred.
ASF (2018) generated a fat right tail on multiple pairs — document as an outlier, do NOT strip it from the historical band.
Renewable-diesel / vegoil substitution and BOZM crush pressure show up first on Z/M — this is the pair most exposed to macro-feed regime shifts.
Placement / farrowing intentions (Hogs & Pigs Sept + Dec) shift the H/J/K deferreds during Q4; expect wider band-width for G/J in Q4 relative to V/Z.
notes: Band = 25/50/75 percentile across last 5 prior calendar years.
Median = 10-year median across last 10 prior calendar years.
Current-year overlay uses THIS year's actual pair.
Year overlays: every prior calendar year since 2010 (band and median unchanged).
ASF year (2018) is retained in the historical band as a documented outlier.
